title: Pages: two new permissions on the approval card

steps.path: Opening a page that asks to see your chats, a program and new conversations (sample 'Work board')
steps.headline: A page that wants your chats and a program says so on the usual card, in plain sentences, before it opens.
steps.changed: Two new lines join the card. Chats: what it can see and change, and what it can't (what was said, renaming, deleting). Program: the file's name, the blunt 'anything your account can do', and three plain consequences. Because this page can also run a program, a quiet line warns it could send your chat list off this computer.
steps.notice: Same card, buttons and order as every other page permission; nothing opens until Allow. Editing the program file later brings this card back.
steps.risk: The card is taller when a page asks for both; on a small window it scrolls.

steps.path: Opening a project page that only looks at that project's chats (sample 'Project chats')
steps.headline: A page that only looks at one project's chats asks for exactly that, and says it can't change anything.
steps.changed: The page names its project, so the card says 'your chats in youcoded'. Look-only pages say they cannot change anything. With no other permissions there is no 'could send your chat list' line.
steps.notice: You can tell at a glance a narrow page from one that reaches everything.
